title: [IMP-4] Broadcast key rotation cannot be countersigned under the one-per-epoch rule
description: Review finding IMP-4: Broadcast key rotation cannot be countersigned under the one-per-epoch rule (lens IMP). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:133-136, :204. Fix: The contradiction is real. The proposed fix is partly wrong: "have the registration service ... issue the rotation announcement itself" fails because the announcement must be signed with the current epoch access private key (05:136, 05:203), which the CO does not hold. The CO is not a publisher-group member and holds no MLS secrets (05:129). Correct fix: make the countersignature uniqueness key (chain, `epoch`, `channelToken`) or (chain, `epoch`, `keyEpoch`), and carry `keyEpoch` in the announcement. A poster still signs. The service countersigns the first request for a given key and returns that same countersigned announcement to later requesters, which settles the race among posters. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
